Getting Started

Three quick steps to set everything up and start generating voiceovers.

1. Install Extension

Get the Vampro Voice Generator Text-to-Speech extension from the Adobe Marketplace and install it.

2. Run Companion App

Download and install the Vampro Voice Service companion app from the Microsoft Store, then launch it.

3. Open Premiere Pro

Inside Premiere Pro, go to Window → UXP Plugins and select Vampro Voice Generator to start using the plugin.
